children: Nocera entered a Strategic Partnership and Joint Distribution Agreement with E-PRO to act as a non-exclusive worldwide distributor of pre-owned iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max devices sourced via iFP Green Technology's buy-back and trade-in program. E-PRO has an allocation of about 600,000 handsets with an awarded value of approximately $520.5 million, which reflects E-PRO's allocation and not Nocera's orders or revenue. The framework agreement has no minimums, shipments are expected in tranches from late September through November 2026 from Texas facilities, and either party may terminate on 30 days' notice; Nocera's supplier registration with iFP is in progress.
: Strategic Partnership and Joint Distribution Agreement (non-exclusive distribution)
: Expand into global pre-owned iPhone distribution channels
